Q4 adjusted EBITDA margin fell to 20.9% on a ₹10 Cr one-time ECL provision; excluding it margin was 25%.

call_points.text: Two PPP contracts come up for renewal this year: a two-clinic Uttarakhand contract and one Andhra Pradesh phase.
Saudi Ministry of Health and Defence dialysis tender has been issued and is at EOI stage; first Riyadh clinic to launch within two months.
Saudi JV is 51:49 and shown as a single share-of-loss line, not consolidated line by line, while participation rights remain.
Management declined to give country-level revenue or patient splits, saying the business should be modelled at consolidated level.
Repair and maintenance is now expensed rather than capitalised, one of three factors lifting FY26 other expenses.
Management sees GLP-1 drugs causing only a 0.25% drop in new patient additions in developed markets, with no effect on emerging-market TAM.
Management remains focused on sustaining growth momentum through organic expansion and platform leverage in FY27.

Network stood at 524 dialysis clinics in 335 cities across five countries, with 44 clinics in the Philippines.

timeline.summary: May 12, 2026: Nephrocare's Philippines step-down subsidiary signed an Asset Transfer Agreement with Orani Hemodialysis Center Inc. to acquire dialysis center assets in Orani, Bataan, for PHP 89,600,000.00.
CRISIL submitted the Q4 FY26 Monitoring Agency Report for Nephrocare Health, showing ₹175.65 Cr of IPO funds utilized to date.
Nephrocare reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹998.8 Cr (+32.2% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA of ₹238.1 Cr (+37.6% YoY).
Nephrocare Health Services Limited hosted an Investors’ Conference Call on May 20, 2026, sharing Q4 & FY26 audited standalone and consolidated financial results via audio recording.

May 26, 2026: Nephrocare's Philippines step-down subsidiary executed two Asset Transfer Agreements to buy dialysis centre assets in Cagayan De Oro City for PHP 27,400,000 (about ₹4.25 Cr) and Aliaga, Nueva Ecija for PHP 44,800,000 (about ₹6.99 Cr).

May 26, 2026: Nephrocare's Singapore wholly-owned subsidiary incorporated NEPHROPLUS HEALTH SERVICES KAZAKHSTAN LLP with KZT 5,000,000 charter capital, a 100%-controlled step-down subsidiary to build a dialysis network in Kazakhstan.

May 27, 2026: Nephrocare filed the transcript of its May 20 Q4 & FY26 earnings call, where management reiterated 15-20% medium-term revenue CAGR guidance and flagged a ₹10 Cr one-time ECL provision behind the Q4 margin dip.
Nephrocare's Philippine subsidiary acquired dialysis center assets in Quezon City for PHP 30 million on June 4, 2026.
Nephrocare Health Services announced that its overseas step-down subsidiary entered into an Asset Transfer Agreement to acquire a dialysis center in Quezon City, Philippines.
